video_title: Tuomas Iisalo on Taylor Hendricks’ growth in Memphis

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Hendricks' rapid development and increased role for the Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: Taylor who's stepping up in a major way who came to us from Utah as an unknown
quotes.quote: There is obviously Taylor who's stepping up in a major way who came to us from Utah as an unknown. We didn't know what he could do when we had him in some of our first games as a five because we didn't have a lot of big guys. He said I've never been really a screener, I've never done this, but you know what he said about that? He said I feel like this will add a dimension to my game and I'm happy that I just want to play. That attitude has carried him very far.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo on Taylor Hendricks stepping up for the Grizzlies: He came to us as an unknown and said I feel like being a screener will add a dimension to my game. That attitude has carried him very far.

structured.context: Coach Tuomas Iisalo discusses Taylor Hendricks' development and his willingness to adapt his role since arriving from Utah.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Hendricks' transformation and impact on the Grizzlies' performance
quotes.excerpt: 27 plus 27 in a 20 point game and just looks like a completely transformed player
quotes.quote: A couple days ago huge plays down the stretch today. We talked about the noise in the plus minus stats, but 27 plus 27 in a 20 point game and just looks like a completely transformed player. So he has a ton of trust in himself, players have a ton of trust in him, and we sure as hell do also.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Hendricks is looking like a completely transformed player for Memphis. Tuomas Iisalo says he has a ton of trust in himself and the team has a ton of trust in him.

structured.context: Coach Tuomas Iisalo praises Taylor Hendricks' recent performance and the trust the team has in his growth.
